idea-plugin.name: Tri-Model AI Orchestrator
idea-plugin.description:
Orchestrate Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini together inside your IDE to write, analyze, review, and refine code under one unified workflow.

Key Capabilities:
  • 5 Multi-Model Orchestration Modes: Role Pipeline (Architect → Coder → Reviewer → Finalizer), Iterative Write-Review-Fix Loop (Coder ↔ Dual Reviewers), Parallel Council & Cross-Critique Consensus, Tri-Model Deep Code Audit, and Parallel Side-by-Side Comparison.
  • Anti-Sycophancy & Precision Agent Skills: Enforces independent judgment (forbidding blind agreement), topic-by-topic peer verification tables ([VERIFIED], [DISPUTED], [MISSING], [UNPROVEN]), blind anonymized peer handoffs, high-precision detail rules, optional Devil's Advocate stress-testing, and an engine-level contradiction guard against rubber-stamp approvals.
  • Flexible Role Assignment: Assign Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini to any engineering role (Architect, Coder, Reviewer, Chair/Synthesizer).
  • Three Compliant Auth Modes per Model: Official REST API Keys (stored in JetBrains PasswordSafe), Temporary Browser OAuth 2.0 (PKCE + 127.0.0.1 loopback) opening your default web browser with RAM-only sessions, or Local CLI tools (claude, codex, gemini).
  • Deep IDE Integration: Attaches active files, code selections, extra workspace files, and live IDE inspection diagnostics; previews proposed edits in the native Diff Viewer; applies single- or multi-file changes atomically with full Undo support.

Privacy & Data Handling:

Prompts, explicitly attached code snippets, and optional editor diagnostics are transmitted directly from your machine to the AI provider endpoints or local CLIs you configure. This extension operates no intermediary backend servers, collects zero telemetry or analytics, and never scrapes browser cookies. API keys are stored exclusively in JetBrains PasswordSafe, and temporary OAuth browser sessions remain strictly in RAM unless you explicitly opt in to persistence. See our Privacy Policy and Security Policy.

idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.4.1
  • Fixed Gemini CLI exit code 55 (untrusted directory): Sets GEMINI_CLI_TRUST_WORKSPACE=true on headless gemini CLI invocations so Test Connection, browser login, and orchestrations work cleanly from any working directory without requiring interactive folder trust.
  • Auto-replace unavailable legacy models in Settings: When live model discovery runs and the previously saved model is not in the provider's available catalog (e.g. a legacy hardcoded default), Settings now automatically switches to an available live model so Test Connection succeeds immediately.
1.4.0
  • Live API & CLI Model Discovery (Zero Hardcoded Presets): Replaced all hardcoded model lists with live model discovery via Anthropic GET /v1/models, OpenAI GET /v1/models, Google Gemini GET /v1beta/models, and official CLIs (gemini models -o json, agy models, codex debug models). Added a live Model picker & Refresh button across Quick Setup and all Settings sign-in modes, with automatic API resolution when no model is pre-selected.
  • Fixed Browser Sign-In across Claude, ChatGPT & Gemini: Stopped opening duplicate browser tabs for codex login and claude auth login (preventing Claude's manual paste-code fallback page from opening over its automatic localhost callback). Fixed gemini CLI browser sign-in by automatically confirming its non-interactive [Y/n] OAuth prompt and closing stdin cleanly, added Sign Out for Gemini CLI, added first-class agy CLI support (fixing -o flag errors), and stripped Codex startup banners from CLI error messages.
  • Cross-Platform Auto-Detection (Linux, Windows & macOS): Added EnvironmentAutoDetector with first-launch detection and 1-click Auto-Detect All in Quick Setup and Settings — discovering OS-specific CLI locations (Windows .exe/.cmd/WinGet/Scoop/Chocolatey/npm, Linux Linuxbrew/Snap/Flatpak/XDG/nvm/fnm/mise, macOS Homebrew/MacPorts/Antigravity), environment API keys & custom base URLs, system/IDE proxy settings, and live available models.
1.3.0
  • Added composable Independent Verification & Anti-Sycophancy Agent Skills (enabled by default): forbids blind agreement between agents, enforces topic-by-topic peer analysis matrices ([VERIFIED], [DISPUTED], [MISSING], [UNPROVEN]), demands concrete symbol/edge-case precision, anonymizes peer brand names in handoffs, and adds optional Strict Adversarial (Devil's Advocate) stress-testing.
  • Added engine-level anti-rubber-stamp contradiction guard: if a reviewer outputs VERDICT: APPROVE while flagging [CRITICAL], [MAJOR], or [DISPUTED] defects, the engine automatically triggers a refinement round.
  • Added quick Agent Skills profile selector directly in the Tool Window header and individual skill toggles in Settings.
1.2.1
  • Fixed ChatGPT (codex) CLI execution outside Git directories by passing --skip-git-repo-check --ephemeral --color never -s read-only (including automatic migration of previously saved configs).
  • Fixed Google Gemini CLI browser sign-in when ~/.gemini/settings.json was previously pinned to gemini-api-key (automatically switches to oauth-personal when clicking Sign In in Browser).
  • Polished Quick Sign-In dialog layout and button/dropdown widths so labels never clip.
1.2.0
  • Simplified sign-in and setup into a single one-screen Sign In dialog (all 3 models side-by-side: 1-click Browser Sign-In via official CLIs with zero Client ID needed, or paste an API Key with 1-click Get Key browser links).
  • Redesigned Settings tabs with a clean card layout showing only the active sign-in mode and collapsing advanced URL/OAuth/CLI fields out of the way.
  • Fixed macOS GUI PATH resolution so PyCharm automatically detects Homebrew and user-local claude, codex, and gemini CLIs, and updated official login commands (claude auth login, codex login, gemini).
1.1.0
  • Added optional Browser OAuth 2.0 (Temporary Session) mode using RFC 8252 localhost loopback (127.0.0.1) and RFC 7636 PKCE (S256) in your default web browser, alongside existing API Key and Local CLI modes.
  • Added RAM-only temporary session mode (clears automatically when PyCharm closes) plus one-click Auth & Sign Out controls in the Tool Window header and Settings.
  • Added Browser Login via CLI helper for Local CLI mode (claude login, codex login, gemini).
1.0.0
  • Initial release integrating Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini under five configurable orchestration workflows.
  • Added native Diff Viewer preview, atomic Undo-capable single- and multi-file apply, and live IDE diagnostics context.
  • Added secure JetBrains PasswordSafe credential storage, environment variable fallback, and local CLI execution mode.
